description: Created a design system built on semantic tokens, accessible primitives, and styled components that bridged engineering and design. Introduced local AI workflows that accelerated development across the team. Helped ship a new document signing product that expanded the platform into a new market segment.
Built the data backbone behind recommendations for 6M+ monthly users. Applied LLMs to decode thousands of real customer experiences, turning unstructured feedback into actionable product insights.

Built the primitives that let anyone add authentication, gated content, and recurring subscriptions to their site, no code required. Integrated user systems with ecommerce and turned complex access control into something creators could configure in minutes.

Created an embeddable platform that partners could integrate with a single line of code. Engineered a theming system that kept hundreds of institutional brands visually distinct while running on shared infrastructure.

Helped grow the engineering team from 4 to 20. Built an internal ERP used company-wide, a load board platform that drove customer acquisition, and a fuel finder that helped truckers map routes with the best fuel discounts.
